# Transfer of the register effect with fixed activity rules

Can the queue reversal be observed without fitting a classifier or using the 2014J presentation? After the archived model comparison, fix two rankings: longer time since last activity first, and fewer total clicks first. Compare both against uniform selection. Apply all three independently to 2013B, 2013J and 2014B at day 60. Use the same 10% module capacity and fractional tie rule. Evaluate current status, 7 and 30 days' reporting delay, and no filter. Summarize the number of actionable subsequent withdrawals by presentation, module, ranking and delay, including omitted presentations with no eligible modules if any. Count presentation-level reversals against uniform under current versus unfiltered status. All three presentations contributed training rows to the original CatBoost. This is a fixed-rule transport check in the same archive. It is not a validation of the trained model at another institution.
